audit.original_abstract_text: Takao asked whether a finite flat commutative group scheme over a Witt ring, killed by p and having quasi-supersingular special fiber, must be Cartier self-dual in ranks p2n with n ≥ 3. For every p > 3 and n ≥ 3, we give a counterexample over W(F̅p). A six-dimensional Dieudonné module has an explicit filtration by supersingular elliptic p-torsion modules, an explicit finite Honda complement, and an image-intersection invariant distinguishing it from its dual. Both the special fiber and its finite flat Witt-ring lift are non-self-dual. The construction is an application of classical Dieudonné and finite Honda theory.
